findings.summary: shipping_cents compares a cents subtotal against FREE_SHIPPING_THRESHOLD defined as 50 dollars, so the free-shipping cutoff is effectively 50 cents and carts like $5.00 ship free instead of paying $7.99.
The new tests only cover an empty cart and a $120 order, so they miss the unit mismatch; no tests cover carts just under and just over the $50 threshold.
